comment: Generic patterns that must never appear in this repo's files or commit messages: issue and pull-request references (bare, or after a name such as owner/name or PR), full pull-request and issue links, section references, and session trailers. Matched case-insensitively, not inside a longer word or number: a hyphen or underscore after a reference does not hide it. Each pattern is written so it does not match its own text here. A consumer may run a stricter list over this repo as well.
